mathematics.assertion_tested: Conditional on mu(g/a0) g = GM/r^2 with mu(y)=1-exp(-y) and constant exterior M, nonlinear near-circular orbit events approach kappa^2/Omega^2=(exp(y)-1+3y)/(exp(y)-1+y).
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Symbolic real y>0 and double-precision floating point for numerical integrations.
mathematics.conventions: GM=a0=1; g>0 is inward acceleration magnitude; Delta_varpi is pericenter-to-pericenter azimuth minus 2*pi.
inputs: DOP853 and RK45 at y=1, epsilon=1e-3
non_claims: No proof of full relativistic action closure.
No test of nonspherical sources or the external-field effect.

checks: Five nonlinear pericenter-event measurements match the analytic limit.
Implicit force residuals are below tolerance.
Near-circular discrepancy decreases quadratically with epsilon.
DOP853 and RK45 event frequencies agree.
result: Implementation and finite assertion verified in the stated range; the displayed algebraic identity is symbolically verified under the stated spherical assumptions.
residual_risks: The parent action and weak-static reduction are not revalidated here.
The numerical grid is finite and excludes y=0.
Only the constant-enclosed-mass exterior branch is integrated.
